{{Quote|The General claims the fall of our homeworld was part of Dooku's plan. The Commerce Guild is expendable, it would seem.|Presidente [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]]|<ref name="RoF" />}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Castell/Legends|Castell]] was '''captured''' by the Republic [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|forces]] in a conflict fought between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="Complete Locations" /> As a result, many [[Gossam/Legends|Gossam]] refugees fled to [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|111|Castell}}</ref>
